biggest_catch: You agree to let Con Edison make small temporary temperature adjustments on hot weekday afternoons (May–September) — you can override any event, but you must stay enrolled and participate in at least 50% of event hours to keep the $25/year retention incentive.
catches: You must have an eligible Wi-Fi smart thermostat and central air conditioning.
You cannot be enrolled in Con Edison's Smart Usage Rewards program at the same time.
Peak events run May–September on weekday afternoons; your thermostat may be adjusted temporarily, with user override available.
The $25/year retention incentive requires participating in at least 50% of event hours during each of the initial three years.
A qualifying thermostat purchase is required if you don't already own an eligible model — that is a purchase condition, not an upfront fee.

steps: Buy an eligible Wi-Fi smart thermostat (check Con Edison's eligible-model list) or use one you already own.
Install it and connect it to your home Wi-Fi and central AC system.
Go to the official Con Edison Smart Thermostat Program page and enroll your thermostat and account.
Stay enrolled through peak season (May–September); you can override any individual event.
Receive your $85 rebate within 6–8 weeks; earn $25/year more by participating in at least 50% of event hours in each of the first three years.
